historical_references.reference: Vaibhavraj was the name of the powerful Maratha king, Shivaji Maharaj's fourth son. He was given this name to signify his prosperity, power and grandeur.
Vaibhavraj was also a renowned Jain monk and philosopher who flourished in the 12th century CE. He is remembered for his works on Jainism, particularly his commentary on the 'Agam Sutra'.
